deviations_from_protocol: horizons are PREFIXES (long) or the 60 s window ending at H (i2v) of ONE 240 s rollout, not separate generations; never pool with the historical whole-file records
VBench-Long temporal_flickering (protocol dimension) is not in this suite: like AIA run_vbench "long" it needs separate static-filter / no-filter runs
VBench-I2V camera_motion (protocol dimension) is not run; one sample per image-prompt (protocol: 5)

i2v dims at 120/240 s are on the final 961-frame window, not the whole video (official loader holds all frames in memory); the 240 s window ends at the last rendered frame when the render has < 3841 frames

VBench-Long per-video value = mean of the official per-clip values (fd18b3d reorganize quirk makes the official per-video list per clip; for SC/BC the fused 0.5/0.5 per-clip values); official aggregate kept
one video per official invocation (AIA batched 8): adds the model-load overhead per horizon
prompts are read from the staged file names (no --prompt_file); none of these dims uses the prompt text
imaging_quality_scale: imaging_quality: official per-clip MUSIQ values are on 0-100 and the official aggregate divides by 100; every value here is on 0-1
